hypotheses.justification: The statement elaborates without it: adeleBddPrincipal, adeleBdd, globalSub and adeleSpace are defined without that class, and adeleBdd_le_adeleSpace (Def_AlgebraicCurve_AdelicIndex.lean line 96) also needs no such hypothesis. The current proof uses it only for globalSub_le_adeleSpace, to apply comap_subtype_sup_of_le_of_le, which needs both A ≤ S and B ≤ S (A = adeleBdd D, B = globalSub K F, S = adeleSpace K F). The equation comap_S(A) ⊔ comap_S(B) = comap_S(A ⊔ B) needs only A ≤ S. If x ∈ S and x = a + b with a ∈ A, b ∈ B, then b = x − a ∈ S, so x is a sum of an element of comap_S(A) and an element of comap_S(B). The reverse inclusion holds for any submodules. A proof: apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective with S.subtype_injective, then map_sup and map_comap_subtype, reducing to (A ⊓ S) ⊔ (B ⊓ S) = (A ⊔ B) ⊓ S. Since A ⊓ S = A, this is A ⊔ (B ⊓ S) = (A ⊔ B) ⊓ S, the modular law for A ≤ S. I have not confirmed Mathlib's exact name (sup_inf_assoc_of_le) or compiled this. No degenerate cases arise, since the argument is purely lattice-theoretic.
